The mornings blossom into noons,

For these little voices: the bee, the fly,
The leaf that taps, the pod that breaks,
The breeze on the grass-tops bending by,

To find a speckled bean, that’s somehow specked,
And somewhere in the pod.’—They left me so.
Shall I leave Marian? have I dreamed a dream?
Like a ripe pod, let the tempest break its heart into pieces, scattering thunders.
An acorn dropped, striking a thin fine powder out of a frail oak pod.

Maybe next year, when I’m richer--
Carved beads and a lotus pod....

How luscious lies the pea within
The pod that Duty locks!
